itemized.notes: FINAL / DISSOLUTION report for Janice Auger, Council At-Large C, filed 1-31-07; p10 is the separate 'Dissolution of a Candidate Campaign' notice. Schedule A runs p3-p7 (hand-numbered 'Page 2..6 of 8') as LANDSCAPE typed sheets that must be rotated COUNTER-clockwise; Schedule B runs p8-p9 ('Page 7..8 of 8') and is already portrait. THE FORM PRINTS AN UNLABELLED '*' COLUMN on both schedules - 12 asterisks on Schedule A and 20 on Schedule B - and NO legend appears anywhere in the 10 pages. Asterisked rows on the two sides pair suggestively (identical dates and amounts: 229.85, 40.00, 20.90, 175.00, 21.95, 11.95, 2000.00, 2625.00, 10000.00, 1500.00, 500.00), which is what an in-kind convention looks like, but the counts do not match and no legend exists, so in_kind is left FALSE on every row and the asterisk is recorded verbatim in each row's note instead of being interpreted. A HUMAN SHOULD RULE ON THE ASTERISK. The Complete Mailing Address column is blank on every page with no ink at 400 dpi, so donor_city/donor_state are blank throughout. THREE Schedule B dates are unparseable and were left blank with needs_review: '05/53/06' (day 53), '06/20806' (malformed), '19/19/06' (month 19). TWO Schedule A dates are well-formed filer typos on a 2006 report - '4/19/2009' and '7/18/2005' - and are kept VERBATIM per the rule that a well-formed typo is retained. Both sides reconcile EXACTLY, and to the same figure, which is the expected shape of a dissolution report closing to zero.
